lede: Mountain Village Town Council has the most consequential meeting of the week on Thursday, November 19 — opening a public hearing on the Metro District's proposed 2027 budget, taking up first readings on both the town budget ordinance and the 2026 property tax levy, and adopting 2027 fee schedules all in one sitting. Meanwhile, HARC takes up the long-delayed preliminary design reviews for the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road Tuesday, and the Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee meets in special session to rule on lottery exceptions that could determine whether a couple closes on a Spruce House unit. The gondola reopens for winter on Friday.

notable.stake: HARC votes on preliminary design for major new Shandoka Lot construction at 860 Black Bear Rd.
THA subcommittee rules on lottery exceptions that decide a real housing purchase outcome.
Norwood considers first-action ordinance restructuring its Planning & Zoning and Board of Adjustment seats.
Mountain Village opens public hearing and takes first readings on 2027 budget and 2026 property tax levy.
